judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Skills Objectives in the same statement grain (Geometry, Unit 11 'Square, rectangle, triangle...'), so the grain rule is satisfied. The second SFI is the P2 (rank 1) objective 'Give examples of materials/objects that have a similar shape to a square, rectangle, and triangle in and outside the classroom'; the first SFI is the P3 (rank 2) objective 'Give examples of objects having the same shape as a square, rectangle, triangle, and circle'. The permitted lower-to-higher direction (P2 to P3) matches a substantive extension: the same shape-matching skill applied to real objects is broadened at P3 to include the circle, and it sits under a P3 Key Unit Competence that also requires drawing/describing and perimeter of the circle-inclusive shape set, whereas P2 targets identification and perimeter of square, rectangle, triangle only. Shared Learning Components for square, rectangle, and triangle (with a P3-only circle LC) corroborate that the P2 competence supports success on the broadened P3 objective rather than being mere repetition. judgment.rationale: Both endpoints are Knowledge Objectives at the same grain and same resolved Grade coordinate P3 (rank 2), sharing the parent Key Unit Competence for whole numbers up to 5000 (Unit 2: Numbers from 0 to 5000). The first concerns using a place-value table to determine the place value of four-digit numbers; the second concerns defining the multiplication of a three-digit number by a two-digit number. They are substantively coherent components of the same multi-digit whole-number competence, and place-value structure is conceptually relevant to multi-digit multiplication, but the second objective is a definitional (conceptual) statement of multiplication rather than a place-value-dependent computational procedure, so the bounded evidence does not substantiate a same-rank developmental dependency in either direction. Token/trigram overlap ('numbers composed of ... digits'), adjacent source pages (105/106), and shared ancestry are nomination signals only. Source evidence for both endpoints is truncated, limiting deeper procedural detail.
